changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.11.2 has been released! This update is required to continue to play online!

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️  
```- Matchmaking will not allow player's to join rooms that are 40k or more VR above their current VR.
- Modified the Donation badge to be a general Supporter badge, which can be used for supporter's through the same donation system, through people who have contributed specific features/files, etc.
- Added voice lines for 10 of the existing characters. Credits to JTG for providing the custom voicelines!
- charaname.txt now allows up to 128 character names. Everything beyond will have to be manually added to the BMGs.
- Added the ability for custom character creators to add custom animation files to their characters! Exact names and details will soon be provided! Thanks to ImZeraora for making this feature!```



# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed an issue where the winning track vote would sometimes display as blocked in the vote screen before it is picked.
- Fixed an issue where the VR multiplier would not update in real time.
- Fixed an issue where the custom item table would display before starting a worldwide from a friend room.
- Fixed an issue where using characters from Patches would crash the game when toggling custom characters on the Retro Rewind channel.
- Fixed an issue where Patches was not working for final lap BRSTM files.
- Fixed an issue where specific characters would freeze the game right before the results. Thanks to ImZeraora for fixing this issue!```


Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip

Please report any and all bugs to <#1263952604363362449> channel! Remember, if we don't know about specific bugs, we cant fix them!
Note: Going to do a 1.5x VR multiplier for the update's release for 2 days, I'd like to try and do this for every update that we release, outside of REALLY small back to back hotfixes!
